column1: # A tag must carry >=3 posts to justify a page: tags do not feed the Fuse.js
# search index (see fuseOpts.keys in config.yml), so a tag's only value is its
# own term page, and a one-post page is a dead end.
# Retired terms, mapped to their successor so a re-run is idempotent and so
# content returning from git history normalizes forward rather than reviving a
# dead tag. static/_redirects covers every URL below.
# Deliberately absent, so the normalizer reports them as UNMAPPED instead of
# rewriting them: these were deleted outright, not merged. A blank target here
# would make normalize-taxonomy.awk emit an empty '- ' list item.
#   Apple, HackerNews, Hackers, InfoSec, Kaminsky, L0pht, Social Media, Video, Windows
